supplementalBreakdowns.basis: Final FY2024 CMS-64 rows total $14,339,047,403 for Virginia's federal Medicaid share. CMS does not publicly release category-of-service quarters, so any annual row still above $10B is an explicit public disclosure ceiling rather than an invented split. Medicaid is a major component of public welfare, but this federal-share boundary is supplemental—not additive—to the broader Census state-government function.

supplementalBreakdowns.title: Virginia SFY2024 Medicaid actual expenditures by service and managed-care population
supplementalBreakdowns.basis: Virginia DMAS reports $21.587032536B of SFY2024 actual expenditures through June across base Medicaid and Medicaid expansion. The rows combine the report's parallel populations within each service category and replace the managed-care subtotal with its two capitation populations and current-year pharmacy rebates. A $1 published-total rounding adjustment reconciles the displayed components. This Medicaid forecast-accounting view is supplemental—not additive—to Census's broader public-welfare function or federal-fiscal-year CMS-64 reporting.
